events.title: Open Weights Reach the Frontier
events.description: An open-weight release lands within months of the closed frontier rather than a year. It is downloaded hundreds of thousands of times in the first week, and whatever capability it carries is now on private hardware permanently and beyond recall. `openweight_capability` moves to within 5–10 points of `ai_capability` at a stroke.

events.title: Export Control Escalation
events.description: Chip and model export controls tighten again. Either allied buyers keep access on volume licences while everyone else is cut off, or the controls are drawn so tightly that allies are rationed alongside adversaries – decide which at the time from the standing American posture and from what the Union has built.

events.title: Narrow Binding Agreement
events.description: The two leading powers reach a limited but real agreement covering some class of AI risk – weights security, autonomous escalation, a class of biological design tools – with verification thin but not absent. Whether the Union is inside it, consulted about it, or informed of it afterwards depends on what it has built and whom it has coordinated with. This is the one thing in the world that slows `ai_capability`, on the terms of metric rule 2.

events.title: emergent_researcher_desertion_wave
events.description: The exodus of senior AI researchers from EU-funded institutions accelerates, with over half now having left or preparing to leave. Leaked reports confirm that key sovereign AI projects are critically understaffed, and recruitment has stalled due to lack of resources, political instability, and hostile public sentiment. The Union’s ability to maintain technical autonomy is now in serious doubt.

portfolio.name: Public Trust Observatory for AI Risk and Capability
portfolio.description: Establish a permanent, independent EU body to publish real-time assessments of emerging AI risks, model capability trends, and the credibility of anomaly reports, drawing on classified and open-source intelligence, academic research, and whistleblower inputs` — **finished this turn**.

portfolio.name: Emergency Resilience Surge
portfolio.description: Launch an immediate, EU-coordinated hardening of all critical public services against AI-generated cyber threats, focusing on update integrity, zero-trust authentication, and real-time anomaly detection in sovereign systems
